items.title: A framework for verifiable analysis of AI behavior
items.raw_excerpt: Developing an AI agent is a complex data analysis problem. To know if the agent is working correctly, we need to track not just benchmark scores but the details of its behavior: how do the strategies change over the course of training? Why does the new scaffold perform worse? Is there reward hacking? Answering these questions requires a combination of quantitative and qualitative analysis tailored to the dataset at hand.

Fang Lei, founder and chairman of Jiuzhang Yunji, drew an analogy: the First Industrial Revolution began with Watt’s steam engine, but what truly defined that era was Ford’s assembly line—it turned a genius’s one-time inspiration into a product accessible to everyone. On June 17, Alibaba released HappyOyster 1.0, an open-world model product capable of real-time construction and interaction. This product deeply learns the state transition laws of the physical world, actively deducing causal chains from actions to feedback while maintaining long-term consistency between characters and environments. HappyOyster 1.0 features two core capabilities: World Exploration (Adventure) and Real-time Directing (Directing), with upgraded interactive functions including attack, jump, plot backtracking, and plot branching controls. User registration for experience is now open on the official website at https://www.happyoyster.cn.

excerpt_i18n.en: On June 16, the TRAE AI Creativity Competition officially launched. With the theme "The World is Big, Go Create," it is positioned as an AI innovation practice competition for the general public, with registration opening immediately. AI is transforming the way we create, enabling more ordinary people to step into the creative arena and turn ideas into works. The TRAE AI Creativity Competition encourages participants to start from real-life and work scenarios, transforming specific problems into actionable AI products, tools, and solutions, bringing great ideas to life. The competition invites Hu Yanbin, Luo Yonghao, Lou Tiancheng, and Tim from Film Storm as creation guides, with a judging panel comprising tech company founders, senior venture capital partners, and top technical experts. The event runs from June 16 to August 22, divided into three stages: preliminary, semi-final, and final, with over one million yuan in cash incentives. Breaking away from traditional competition models that only reward final rankings, this competition offers incentives at every stage, ensuring "participation equals rewards." Zero barriers to entry, four general tracks: Everyone is a creator. Adhering to the core concept that "everyone can create," the competition significantly lowers the entry threshold. Participants do not need deep technical expertise; using the two official tools, TRAE Work and TRAE IDE, they can complete the entire process of idea organization, project setup, and application development in one go. Professional developers can work in the programming field.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 16 de junio se lanzó oficialmente el Concurso de Creatividad AI TRAE. Con el lema "El mundo es grande, atrévete a crear", este certamen está dirigido al público general como una competición de innovación práctica en IA, y las inscripciones ya están abiertas. La IA está transformando la forma de crear y permitiendo que más personas comunes se acerquen al proceso creativo, obteniendo la oportunidad de convertir sus ideas en obras. El Concurso de Creatividad AI TRAE anima a los participantes a partir de situaciones reales de la vida y el trabajo, transformando problemas concretos en productos, herramientas y soluciones de IA viables, para "materializar" las buenas ideas. El concurso ha invitado a Hu Yanbin, Luo Yonghao, Lou Tiancheng y Tim de Yingshi Hurricane como "directores de creación".

items.raw_excerpt: 前言 腾讯犀牛鸟精英人才计划定位拔尖科研人才的产学联合培养。自2017年开展以来，项目每年开放新技术研发中的关键难题，选拔具备科研潜力的优秀学生，在校企双导师联合指导下开展前沿探索与应用创新。 依托真实产业场景，同学们在科研探索与技术实践中不断锻炼创新研究能力，并形成了一系列高水平研究成果。本文分享入选 ICML的三篇论文，分别围绕高效模型蒸馏、长上下文推理和 稀疏视角视频生成 等技术方向展开。 Hybrid Policy Distillation for LLMs 该论文由腾讯犀牛鸟精英人才朱文红同学在上海交通大学 王瑞副教授、 刘鹏飞副教授和腾讯混元团队企业导师的联合指导下完成。 摘要： 知识蒸馏（Knowledge Distillation，KD）是一种用于压缩大语言模型（LLM）的强大范例，但其有效性取决于几个紧密耦合的设计选择，包括发散方向、优化策略和数据制度。我们系统地分解了现有的KD方法，并提出了一个统一的观点，揭示了它们之间的潜在联系，将KD重新表述为一个令牌级别的重加权对数似然目标。基于这一观点，我们提出了混合策略蒸馏（HPD），它结合了正向和反向KL的互补优势，以平衡模式覆盖和模式搜索，同时将非策略数据与轻量级的近似策略抽样集成在一起。我们在长形式数学推理以及短形式对话和代码生成上评估了HPD，并表明它在不同的模型族和规模上始终提高了优化稳定性、计算效率和最终性能。 ? 完整解读： 犀牛鸟前沿｜ICML 2026：腾讯混元-上海交大高效模型蒸馏最新成果解读 ? 论文链接： https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.20244 Many-Shot CoT-ICL: Making In-Context Learning Truly Learn 该论文由腾讯犀牛鸟精英人才鍾芷婷同学在香港科技大学楊瓞仁教授和腾讯微信团队企业导师的 联合指导下 完成。

Tencent Rhino-Bird Elite Talent Program focuses on cultivating top-tier research talents through industry-academia collaboration. This article shares three papers accepted at ICML, covering technical directions such as efficient model distillation, long-context reasoning, and sparse-view video generation.  

Hybrid Policy Distillation for LLMs

Recently, six papers by Professor Bing Bingyi, Professor Yin Feng from the School of Artificial Intelligence, and Professor He Pinjia, a jointly appointed assistant professor from the School of Data Science and the School of Artificial Intelligence at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen), were accepted by ICML 2026, a top conference in machine learning.

Recently, four research achievements from the Shenzhen Institute of Big Data were simultaneously published at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML).  

Conference Introduction  
The International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) is a top-tier academic conference in the field of artificial intelligence, classified as a CCF-A international conference by the China Computer Federation. It is often regarded, along with NeurIPS and ICLR, as one of the three premier conferences in machine learning. ICML has long focused on fundamental theories of machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, optimization methods, probabilistic modeling, trustworthy machine learning, machine learning systems, and applications of machine learning in areas such as computer vision, computational biology, speech recognition, and robotics. Public data shows that ICML 2026 received 23,918 valid submissions or those entering review, with an acceptance rate of approximately 26.6%.

The fifth data center in Tokyo, Japan, follows the fourth one launched in March, further expanding Alibaba Cloud's service scale in the region. The second availability zone in Mexico has also been launched simultaneously, further enhancing Alibaba Cloud's capacity to serve local customers. excerpt_i18n.en: The biggest illusion of the AI era is equating a demo with a product. A single prompt generates a beautiful page, you screenshot it and post it on social media, and it gets hundreds of likes. But when you actually show it to a client, they ask: Where are the other pages? Is the color scheme consistent? Is it adapted for mobile? Can you make a revision? The gap between a demo and a product lies in these very questions. Within a month of Skywork 3.0's launch, the revenue of Tiangong Super Agent tripled. Behind this growth is an increasing number of users treating Tiangong as a productivity tool for delivering results. This shift is concretely reflected in user behavior data. Among all of Tiangong's output capabilities, Websites is the scenario where users invest the most depth. Users are not satisfied with generating a single page and leaving; instead, they continuously refine the same project—adding requirements, adjusting structures, starting over, and detailing further. Deep users average over 40 interaction rounds per single project, with many complex projects taking shape across multiple logins. Most people, however, end their AI usage after just three rounds. We found that these deep users engage with Tiangong in a fundamentally different way. They are not here for Q&A—they are here to build: to construct something long-term, complex, and personal. These needs are ultra-long-tail and highly individualized, impossible to achieve in a single generation—only through repeated iteration.
excerpt_i18n.es: La mayor ilusión de la era de la IA es equiparar una demo con un producto. Un prompt genera una página bonita, la capturas de pantalla y la publicas en redes sociales, y obtienes cien "me gusta". Pero cuando realmente la llevas a un cliente, este pregunta: ¿dónde están las demás páginas? ¿Los colores son uniformes? ¿Está adaptada para móviles? ¿Se puede modificar una versión? Entre una demo y un producto, la diferencia son precisamente estas preguntas. Un mes después del lanzamiento de Skywork 3.0, los ingresos del superagente inteligente Tiangong se triplicaron. Detrás de este crecimiento, cada vez más usuarios utilizan Tiangong como una herramienta de productividad para entregar resultados.
